reflection.review:
4 of 4 planned attempts completed (2 measurement, 2 optimizer) plus the
budget-scaling measurement. 0 records moved; that was a possible and
informative outcome by design. Frontier stands at reg3_250 39.95 /
sycamore_m20 61.544 (`ref:treesa-inf`).

- 021 (measurement): certified **tc ≥ 18** for reg3_250 via a
  minor-verified treewidth LB of the line graph (twalgor `UpLow`,
  certificate independently checked by two exact PACE solvers). LB
  machinery stalls far below the structural truth (tw(L) ∈ [18, 34]).
- 022 (measurement): sycamore_m20 optimum localized to **[53, 61.544]**:
  rigorous balanced-cut lemma + explicit 53-wire temporal cut. Proved the
  frontier is **width-optimal** (sc = 53 is the minimum any tree can
  achieve; hence tw(L) = 52). Identified that ALL width/cut/treewidth
  bounds cap at 53 — the residual 8.5 ≈ log2(#near-max contractions) is
  inherent to the log-sum objective and needs a sum-form bound.
- 023 (draft, hierarchical exact, agglomerative): scored 40.024/61.571, no
  records. Exact super-trees over ~170 coarsenings landed 0.4–2.3 above
  the plateau.
- 024 (draft, hierarchical exact, spacetime blocks): scored 39.949/61.607,
  no records (reg3 tie to +0.001 = noise). Block trees catastrophically
  worse (tc ≈ 130) — block-internal cost dominates before the exact top
  level can act.
- Budget scaling (treesa-inf, 90/300/900 s): flat within noise
  (39.94→39.88→39.95 / 61.61→61.58→61.51). The plateau is structural, not
  budget-limited, at these sizes.

Protocol notes: 021/022 are measurement attempts — no validator scoring by
design (nothing to score; they set no records); deliverables are certified
bounds with reproducible certificates in their worktrees. 023/024 read
cap-era protocol files (worktrees predated the v2.1 commit) and
self-imposed the old sc caps; scored results are unaffected (their trees
sit at the frontier under pure tc), but 023's DP pruned with a constraint
that no longer exists — its null is corroborated by 024's cap-independent
mechanism, not standalone. v2.1 protocol committed mid-cycle to stop this
class of staleness.
reflection.evidence:
- Sycamore: optimum ∈ [53, 61.544]; frontier width-optimal; tw(L) = 52.
- reg3_250: tc ≥ 18 certified; structural picture 39.95 ≈ 34 + ~6.
- Blacklist: coarsen-then-exact (023/024); width-based LB machinery as the
  sole certification route on expander line graphs (021).
- Plateau is budget-independent at current sizes (scaling measurement).
- Open: the profile (sum-form) bound and profile-aware search — cycle 5.
reflection.literature:
Sum-form/isoperimetric bounds for contraction cost do not appear in the
project KB — [markov_2005_simulating] and the PACE line are max-form;
[gray_2020_hyper] reports empirical plateaus without bounding them. The
width-optimality proof for a Sycamore-class proxy plus the inherent-residual
argument appears novel. 022's temporal-cut value matches the qubit-count
intuition in the RQC simulation literature ([liu_2022_verifying] slicing
practice). Cycle-5's profile objective has no direct antecedent in the KB.
